messages:
jade: Quick follow-up on the modularization RFC. Propose we extract 'hotpath cache' and 'session router' into small daemons behind a narrow proto over unix socket first. Keep contracts tiny.

omar: +1. Biggest worry is tail latency. Suggest spike with loopback socket to measure.

li: I'll run a 48h spike with a shim that forwards to in-process path and report p50/p95/p99. Also add a micro-bench for get_many.

sophie: Rollout idea: tenant cohorts -> read-only -> write flip. Add automatic fallback to in-process if p99 > threshold. Need kill switch and SRE runbook.

deploy-bot: infra: created task provision-socket-ns-614 for spike env.

jade: Security: sidecars must use short-lived creds and accept signed ephemeral tokens. No blanket KMS access.

omar: Contract sketch (minimal):
```
POST /cache/get_many
headers: { x-tenant-id, x-trace-id }
body: { keys: ["k1","k2"], max_staleness_ms: 50 }
response: { entries: [{key:"k1", value:"...", from:"mem|db"}] }
```

li: Will post numbers by EOD tomorrow. If numbers look fine we proceed to a 1-week read-only canary.

jade: Thanks all. I'll open the tracking RFC and link it here. Roll forward unless objections.
